tool_args.rationale: Acquire the relevant fine trajectory batch to add observations beyond the five existing rows and distinguish the remaining dynamical mechanisms; the failed fresh confirmation rules out submitting the current Kelvin–Voigt model.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a static or simple creep model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The two-parameter Kelvin–Voigt fit was refuted with confirmation RMSE 0.354251, far above 0.045; the five existing rows do not identify the alternative mechanism.
It is explicitly irrelevant and would not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
The evidence indicates a refuted stationary model, not high-frequency chaotic oscillations or demonstrated failure of all stationary smooth mechanisms.
